hooks.name: Rules integrity check
hooks.description: When rules/masshealth.yaml changes, validate each rule's source and status, run the ledger tests, and list ledger outcomes affected by newly confirmed rules.

action.prompt: Check that every rule has a source and a status (confirmed, provisional, or unresolved; source may be null only if unresolved). Then run `npm test -- tests/ledger` and report failures. If a rule changed from unresolved to confirmed, list which ledger outcomes could change.
